verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the custom stablecoins doc, which says branded stablecoins are backed 1:1 by USDC and that Coinbase manages issuance, redemption, and reserves. That is a single high-level statement about reserve backing; nothing in the pack covers reserve composition detail, attestations, or any yield or rewards program. missing for 10: detailed reserve composition disclosure, third-party attestation reports, yield/rewards program documentation, eligibility criteria, plainly stated regulatory caveats, independent corroboration.
